name: Stanley Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Stanley Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive equipment, component, and electronic application products in Japan, the United States, Asia Oceania, Chain, and internationally.
